messages:
sasha: publish pipeline failed during the SDK publish step. typegen generated a rename from `UserMeta` -> `UserMetadata` and semver guard bumped a minor. anyone know why a type alias rename happened automatically? :confused:
ci-bot: publish-job-7733 failed: changelog.semver_check failed. Detected version diff 0.9.8 -> 0.10.0. See: https://ci.internal/redwood/7733/logs
ryan: hmm, did we run the new openapi spec or an intermediate merged file? alias renames usually come from the codegen templates or spec-level ref-name changes.
laura: i dug in: a recent backend PR normalized a $ref name in the contract generator, changing `UserMeta` -> `UserMetadata` to align with other refs. The spec compile task auto-applied that normalized ref name. Typegen faithfully emitted the new identifier which looks breaking to the semver checker.
sasha: the backend change is semantically identical. This is a tooling name normalization leak. We need a way to map safe rename rules so they don't force semver bumps.
ryan: short-term: ops can approve a docs-only override but we should not do that often. Longer term: typegen should consult a compatibility mapping (ref alias map) and treat certain ref-name-only renames as docs-only. Also codegen templates should prefer original published ref names unless overridden.
laura: agreed. I've started a fix in the contract-compiler to emit a stability layer: keep an x-original-ref header during spec generation so downstream tools can detect cosmetic renames. opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/contract-compiler/pull/112
ci-bot: artifacts for job 7733 preserved at s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/publish/7733. changelog output by typegen v0.19.0 includes: "Rename UserMeta -> UserMetadata"
ops-releases: short-term playbook: add label `publish/ref-rename-ack` that release lead can apply if change is documented and validated. Also require a brief note in releases channel when used.
sasha: can we also add a linter in the semver check that flags pure-ref-name renames separately and includes the original-ref hint from the contract-compiler? then we could auto-classify as docs-only when match found.
ryan: good idea. i'll prototype the semver guard normalization to consult x-original-ref and produce a normalized diff before semver evaluation. will open MR for the guard.
laura: contract-compiler PR will include the x-original-ref header and a migration test. will link the typegen and semver-guard followups.
sasha: thanks. for now ops will apply the override so the release can proceed. please record the justification in the releases channel and include the PR refs.
ops-releases: applied label `publish/ref-rename-ack`. Release unblocked. Remember to attach the contract-compiler PR + typegen follow-ups to the release ticket.
ryan: filing follow-ups: typegen support for original-ref mapping, semver-guard normalized diff, and codegen template guardrails. ETA for prototypes: end of week.
sasha: perfect. let's keep scope tight so we don't accumulate more manual overrides. :thumbsup:
